messages:
alex: heads-up — sec-bot flagged an exposed GH Actions token in staging workflow file `ci/pipeline-staging.yml` :eyes:
sec-bot: automated alert: github.actions.token_exposed detected in repo redwood-staging, evidence: https://gist.github.com/redacted (accessed).
maria: ugh, thanks alex. what permissions does the token have?
alex: scoped to repo:write and actions:read. used by a scheduled deploy job for internal staging only. token was added via a PR from a fork — looked like a dev convenience slip.
sam: ok first steps: revoke any tokens immediately and rotate credentials. who can revoke the token in GitHub? @jordan?
jordan: I can revoke the token. will do now and post confirmation. also can remove the workflow trigger until we've audited.
ops-lead: please also quarantine any infra access the token might have had. check CloudTrail for assume-role/API calls from actions-runner identity.
sec-bot: note: matching KMS usage found in logs — an encrypt call to projects/redwood-kms/staging-key around 1933337600 from CI runner. please verify decrypt attempts.
maria: good catch. sam, can you run a quick KMS audit? Need list of decrypts in the window + which service accounts used.
sam: running query against audit logs now. snippet I ran: ```gcloud logging read "resource.type=audited_resource AND protoPayload.methodName=\"cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt\"" --limit 50 --project=infra-staging```
sam: preliminary: 3 decrypt calls by serviceAccount:github-actions@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com between 1933337500-1933337600. No other unexpected principals.
alex: action list I propose:
• revoke GH token (jordan)
• remove/disable the workflow (jordan)
• rotate any secrets encrypted with that KMS key (maria + sam)
• create a short-term RBAC rule blocking serviceAccount:github-actions from decrypting until we confirm least-privilege (ops-lead)
• enable detailed audit forwarding for KMS/decrypt to Splunk for 30d (maria)
• notify impacted staging teams + run smoke tests (eng-sre)

jordan: revoked token and disabled workflow. commit: `revert ci/pipeline-staging.yml` and left a note in the PR. timestamp: 1933337730.
ops-lead: applying temporary deny-binding to restrict decrypt on staging key for github-actions principal now. command I used: ```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding staging-key --member=serviceAccount:github-actions@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter --project=infra-staging```
ops-lead: added a conditional allow for a specific short-lived SA for deploy job instead (we'll rotate that SA creds).
maria: starting rotation plan: list of secrets encrypted under staging-key -> create new key version, re-encrypt latest plaintext, update secret manager references. I'll post playbook in the runbook channel.
sam: audit logs show decrypts used only by that github-actions SA and the staging deploy SA. recommend rotating the deploy SA keys and replacing any long-lived tokens with workload identity where possible.
alex: for compliance: we need to capture timeline + actions for audit. I'll draft an incident note and tag legal/privacy if any data exfil risk.
jordan: smoke tests passed for staging after disabling workflow. No production impact.
maria: I'll create a short-runbook: steps + commands + who to ping. rough steps: 1) create new key version 2) rewrap secrets 3) update Secret Manager 4) rotate deploy SA keys 5) re-enable workflow behind temp approval.
sec-bot: reminder: escalate if any decrypt attempts occur from unknown principals after the deny-binding is removed.
ops-lead: final ask — let's add a GitHub org policy: disallow secrets in PR branches from forks and block merges until secret scanning clears. Also enable org-level SSO for actions with OIDC where possible.
alex: agreed. maria, can you own the GH policy change? sam can assist with OIDC setup.
maria: on it. I'll file a change request and schedule an hour with platform to flip the org policy and test OIDC flows. ETA EOD today.
alex: thanks everyone. I'll update the incident doc with timestamps and owners. closing after postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. :lock:
